scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Financial assistance scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu to encourage female students from government schools to pursue higher education (undergraduate degrees, diplomas, ITI) without financial burden.
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month direct bank transfer until completion of undergraduate course / diploma.
application_steps: Enroll in an accredited college / university / polytechnic after passing 12th standard from a TN Government school.
Submit Aadhaar, bank passbook, and school transfer certificate (TC) to the college nodal officer.
College nodal officer registers the student on the official Pudhumai Penn portal.
Monthly incentive of ₹1,000 is directly credited via DBT to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

benefits.text: ₹1,000 per month direct financial grant into student's bank account throughout course duration.
Prevents female dropout rates and promotes women empowerment through higher education.

documents.name: School Transfer Certificate / Study Certificate
documents.notes: Proof of studying 6th to 12th std in TN Govt school

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.notes: Mandatory for DBT authentication

documents.name: Bank Passbook Copy
documents.notes: Single-holder savings account in student's name linked with Aadhaar

documents.name: College Admission Proof / ID Card
documents.notes: Bonafide student certificate from current institution

department: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC), Special Programme Implementation Department
description: Flagship youth skill enhancement initiative by the Government of Tamil Nadu providing industry-aligned technical, vocational, soft skills, and emerging tech training to college students and job seekers.
benefits_summary: Free industry-certified courses, technical skill training, and recruitment placement drives.
application_steps: Register on the Naan Mudhalvan portal using mobile number and student/citizen credentials.
Browse domain-specific courses (Technology, Engineering, Banking, Logistics, IT).
Complete coursework and earn industry-recognized certification.
Participate in statewide campus and regional job placement drives.

benefits.text: Free access to emerging tech courses (Data Science, Cloud, EV, AI, Embedded Systems).
Direct placement opportunities with top industrial and IT employers in Tamil Nadu.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.notes: Identity and Tamil Nadu residency proof

documents.name: College / Educational Qualification Certificate
documents.notes: Proof of current student or graduate status

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Central Sector Scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to assist in procuring agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year directly credited in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000.
application_steps: Visit the PM-KISAN official portal or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) / e-Sevai centre.
Fill in Farmer Registration Form with Aadhaar number, bank account details, and land ownership record.
Complete mandatory Aadhaar-based e-KYC on the portal via OTP or biometric authentication.
State agriculture department verifies records and approves DBT disbursement.

benefits.text: ₹6,000 annual direct income support credited directly into bank account via DBT.
Timely financial support prior to sowing/harvest seasons for seeds, fertilizers, and equipment.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.notes: Mandatory for registration and biometric e-KYC

documents.name: Land Records / Patta / Chitta
documents.notes: Proof of cultivable agricultural land ownership

documents.name: Bank Account Passbook
documents.notes: Aadhaar-seeded bank account for DBT payment

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance scheme implemented by the Government of Tamil Nadu covering low-income families for specified serious ailments, surgeries, and diagnostic procedures.
benefits_summary: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across network hospitals.
application_steps: Obtain Income Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Revenue Department showing annual income ≤ ₹1,20,000.
Visit District Kiosk at District Collectorate or designated Taluk Hospital with Smart Family Ration Card.
Submit biometric and demographic details to receive CMCHIS Smart Card.
Show CMCHIS Card at any empaneled government or private hospital for cashless treatment.

benefits.text: Up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for over 1,090 surgical procedures and 400+ medical packages.
Cashless coverage at over 1,000 government and private empaneled hospitals across Tamil Nadu.

documents.name: Smart Family Ration Card
documents.notes: Proof of Tamil Nadu family residency

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.notes: Issued by VAO/Revenue showing annual income ≤ ₹1.2 Lakhs

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Family Members
documents.notes: For individual beneficiary identification

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme, providing a health cover of ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.
benefits_summary: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance coverage per family per year for hospital care.
application_steps: Check beneficiary eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in using mobile number, Aadhaar, or Ration Card.
Complete e-KYC online or visit nearest CSC / Ayushman Mitra at an empaneled hospital.
Download Ayushman Card (Golden Card) upon approval.
Avail cashless hospital admission and treatment across all empaneled hospitals nationwide.

benefits.text: ₹5,00,000 health cover per family per year with no cap on family size or age.
Covers medical examinations, treatments, consultation, pre- and post-hospitalization costs for 3 days and 15 days.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.notes: Mandatory identity and biometric verification document

documents.name: Ration Card / PMJAY Family Letter
documents.notes: Proof of beneficiary inclusion in eligible database

department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Flagship scheme to fund the unfunded by facilitating collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 Lakhs (up to ₹20 Lakhs for Tarun Plus) to micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises.
benefits_summary: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 Lakhs across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
application_steps: Prepare business plan/proposal for setting up or expanding small enterprise (shop, service, manufacturing).
Apply online through the official UdyamiMitra portal or visit any commercial, regional rural, or microfinance bank.
Submit identity proof, address proof, business address proof, and quotation for machinery/goods.
Bank reviews application and disburses loan without requiring collateral security.

benefits.text: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for new starters.
Kishore: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 Lakhs for middle-stage development.
Tarun: Loans above ₹5 Lakhs and up to ₹10 Lakhs for established enterprises.
Zero collateral security required; nominal processing charges for micro-loans.

documents.name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
documents.notes: Mandatory identity verification

documents.name: Proof of Residence
documents.notes: Recent utility bill / Aadhaar / Ration card

documents.name: Business Address and Registration Proof (if existing)
documents.notes: Udyam registration or shop license

documents.name: Bank Account Statements
documents.notes: Last 6 months bank statement

department: Department of Industries and Commerce (MSME), Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Self-employment scheme in Tamil Nadu to mitigate unemployment among youth by facilitating institutional loan finance with a 25% Government capital subsidy for establishing micro-enterprises in manufacturing, service, and business sectors.
benefits_summary: Loan finance up to ₹15 Lakhs for manufacturing / ₹5 Lakhs for service/business with 25% govt subsidy.
application_steps: Apply online on the official Tamil Nadu MSME Online portal (msmeonline.tn.gov.in/uyegp).
Upload 8th/10th pass certificate, TC, Aadhaar, project profile, and community/income certificate.
Attend interview conducted by District Task Force Committee (DTFC) at District Industries Centre (DIC).
Upon DTFC recommendation, bank sanctions loan and DIC releases 25% government subsidy.

benefits.text: Project cost up to ₹15 Lakhs for manufacturing, ₹5 Lakhs for service, and ₹5 Lakhs for business.
25% government capital subsidy (up to ₹1.25 Lakhs) directly adjusted against bank loan.
Mandatory 7-day Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training included free of cost.

documents.name: Educational Qualification Certificate
documents.notes: Minimum 8th pass certificate / TC

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Proof of Residence
documents.notes: Minimum 3 years residence proof in Tamil Nadu

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.notes: Family annual income not exceeding ₹5 Lakhs

documents.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
documents.notes: Cost estimate and machinery quotation for proposed business

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / TN Urban Habitat Development Board
description: Flagship mission of Government of India to provide all-weather pucca houses to eligible urban households belonging to EWS, LIG, and MIG categories across India, including Tamil Nadu.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance / interest subsidy up to ₹2.5 Lakhs for construction or purchase of pucca house.
application_steps: Log on to the PMAY-U official portal or visit local urban local body (Municipality/Corporation) office / CSC.
Choose component: Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction (BLC) or Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP).
Submit Aadhaar details, family income details, and land/property documents.
Municipal / District authorities inspect site and release milestone-based construction grants.

benefits.text: Central assistance up to ₹1.5 Lakhs per house under Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).
Additional state government top-up subsidy provided through TN Urban Habitat Development Board.
Ensures permanent housing with basic water, sanitation, and electricity connections.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
documents.notes: Mandatory beneficiary identification

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.notes: Annual family income certificate for EWS/LIG classification

documents.name: Land Title / Patta Document
documents.notes: Proof of ownership of clear land for construction (for BLC)

documents.name: Affidavit confirming no other pucca house owned in India
documents.notes: Mandatory self-declaration

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
department: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), Ministry of Rural Development / TN Revenue Dept
description: Non-contributory monthly pension scheme for senior citizens aged 60 years and above living Below Poverty Line (BPL) to provide dignified social security and livelihood support in old age.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (standard in Tamil Nadu through combined state-central NSAP funding).
application_steps: Apply online via Tamil Nadu e-Sevai portal (tnesevai.tn.gov.in) or visit local Taluk Office / Revenue Inspector.
Submit proof of age (Aadhaar/Voter ID), BPL card/Ration card, and bank passbook.
Village Administrative Officer (VAO) and Revenue Inspector inspect and certify destitution / income status.
Special Tahsildar sanctions pension order, credited directly to the senior citizen's bank account every month.

benefits.text: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 directly credited to bank account or postal savings.
Provides essential financial independence for senior citizens lacking familial support.

documents.name: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
documents.notes: Applicant must be 60 years or older

documents.name: BPL Card / Family Ration Card
documents.notes: Proof of economic status below poverty line

documents.name: Bank Passbook Copy
documents.notes: Single savings account in applicant's name

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons
department: Directorate for Welfare of the Differently Abled, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Welfare scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu providing monthly financial maintenance allowance to persons with severe disabilities (40% and above disability, intellectual disability, muscular dystrophy, leprosy, Parkinson's disease).
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 to ₹2,000 directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
application_steps: Obtain Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / National Disability Identity Card from District Differently Abled Welfare Officer (DDAWO).
Submit application via Tamil Nadu e-Sevai portal or directly at the District Collectorate DDAWO office.
Submit Aadhaar, UDID card, medical board certificate, and bank details.
Monthly allowance is sanctioned and credited directly into beneficiary's bank account via ECS.

benefits.text: ₹1,500 to ₹2,000 monthly maintenance allowance credited through electronic clearance (ECS).
Assists severely differently abled persons in meeting daily subsistence and medication expenses.

documents.name: UDID Card / Disability Certificate
documents.notes: Medical board certificate indicating ≥ 40% disability

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.notes: Proof of identity and residence in Tamil Nadu

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.notes: Bank account linked with Aadhaar in beneficiary's name

department: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD), Government of India
description: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage loss compensation and promoting healthy institutional birth and child immunization.
benefits_summary: ₹5,000 for 1st living child (in 2 installments) and ₹6,000 for 2nd child if newborn is a girl.
application_steps: Register pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) / Primary Health Centre (PHC) within 150 days of LMP.
Fill Form 1A with Mother-Child Protection (MCP) card and Aadhaar details on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
First installment (₹3,000) credited upon registration and at least one antenatal checkup.
Second installment (₹2,000) credited upon institutional childbirth and primary vaccination.

benefits.text: ₹5,000 direct cash incentive in 2 installments for the first child.
Additional ₹6,000 one-time grant if the second born child is female to incentivize girl child survival.

documents.name: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card
documents.notes: Issued by Government Health Centre / Anganwadi

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Mother and Husband
documents.notes: Mandatory identity proof for DBT

documents.name: Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook of Mother
documents.notes: Single bank account in woman's name

scheme_name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) on Education Loans
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
description: Central scheme providing full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period + 1 year) on education loans availed by students from economically weaker sections for recognized technical and professional courses in India.
benefits_summary: 100% interest subsidy during course study and 1-year moratorium period on education loans.
application_steps: Apply for educational loan through the official Vidya Lakshmi portal (vidyalakshmi.co.in) at any scheduled commercial bank.
Submit annual gross parental income certificate (≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs) issued by competent state revenue authority.
Bank flags loan account under CSIS on the Canara Bank nodal portal.
Government of India reimburses entire loan interest to bank during the study and moratorium period.

benefits.text: Full interest waived during entire course duration plus one year post-completion.
Significant financial relief for students pursuing engineering, medicine, and professional degrees.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.notes: Gross annual family income ≤ ₹4.5 Lakhs from authorized authority

documents.name: Admission Confirmation & Fee Structure
documents.notes: Bonafide proof of enrollment in recognized professional college

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
documents.notes: Borrower and co-borrower identity documents

department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
description: Central scheme providing free LPG (cooking gas) connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, to replace unsafe cooking fuels with clean cooking gas.
benefits_summary: Free LPG connection plus financial assistance for the first refill and stove, deposit-free.

department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
description: Government-sponsored crop insurance scheme providing affordable, comprehensive risk cover for farmers against crop loss from non-preventable natural risks, from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
benefits_summary: Insurance payout for crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and disease; premium cost shared between farmer and government.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
description: Micro-credit scheme providing affordable working capital loans to urban street vendors to help them resume and grow their livelihoods.
benefits_summary: Collateral-free working capital loans in escalating tranches for street vendors, with interest subsidy on timely repayment.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Government of India
description: Government-backed voluntary pension scheme open to Indian citizens aged 18-40 with a savings bank account, providing a fixed guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 based on contributions made.
benefits_summary: Fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60, depending on the contribution slab chosen.
